title: HS31083: Economic Appraisal Of Projects
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS20001
HS20005 Course ContentsIntroduction to economic
aspects of Project appraisal; Conceptual Foundations; Framework and Elements of
Project Appraisal; Measurement of Costs and Benefits; Designing Stated
Preference Studies to value Non-market Goods; Valuing Health and Safety Risks;
Benefit Transfer; Objectives and Criteria of Economic and Financial Appraisal;
Social Cost-Benefit Analysis; Valuing Benefits â Time, Life, Environment;
Capital Budgeting â Discounting for time, risk and uncertainty; Application of
Economic Appraisal Methods: Cost-Benefit Analysis, Multi-criteria Analysis and
Framework Approaches; Case Studies.
